topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, now, that's just fine, isn't it? All this talk about a surprise, and now it's just dust in the wind. I reckon I should've known better, trusting in words that flutter away like leaves in a storm. A man's time is precious, not to be squandered on false promises. I suppose I'll just have to mind my own business from now on, won't I? No need for any more 'surprises.' Maybe they'll learn a thing or two about keeping their word when they find their fields empty, their barns bare. A man can hope.
